title: Reproduction of NOAA Analysis of Methane in Air, Table A1
selection: All 41 records in Table A1: 20 unknown-sample injections and 21 bracketing reference injections. No filtering or invented inputs.

columns.time: Time as printed, time zone unspecified
columns.baseline_code: BB copied unchanged, not interpreted or used in the calculation
columns.area: Peak area in the instrument units of the original table, physical unit not specified
columns.reported_ratio: NOAA response ratio, printed to nine decimal places
columns.reported_ch4_ppb: NOAA calibrated dry-air mole fraction in ppb, input to the mean calculation

calibration_scale: WMO CH4 X2004A, as specified by the technical procedure
calculation: For each S row divide its area by the arithmetic mean of the immediately preceding and following R areas. Compare with published ratios. Compute the arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (N-1 denominator) of the 20 published ppb values.
scope: Original chromatograms and numerical calibration coefficients are not provided in Table A1. The ratio-to-ppb conversion is not reproduced or inferred by fitting the rounded outputs.
credit: Data provided by NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Boulder, Colorado, USA. Transcription, calculation and figure by Klimatologie.eu.
